claim.claim-text: 1. A method of fabricating a device for detecting at least one analyte in a sample, comprising fabricating a film that contains a plurality of droplets containing materials for sensing an analyte, said droplets dispersed within a hydrophobic barrier, wherein said hydrophobic barrier separates said droplets from said sample but permits diffusion of said analyte through said hydrophobic barrier.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the hydrophobic barrier is at least partially comprised of an oil supported by a solid scaffold.
3. The method of claim 2, wherein the hydrophobic barrier is comprised of a plurality of miscible oils.
4. The method of claim 2, wherein the hydrophobic barrier is comprised of a plurality of immiscible oils.
5. The method of claim 1, further comprising adding an emulsifier or surfactant to a precursor material to the hydrophobic barrier.

6. The method of claim 5, further comprising subsequently blending the precursor material with a solvent and sensing material in order to cause the plurality of droplets containing materials for sensing an analyte to be dispersed within the hydrophobic barrier.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the hydrophobic barrier has an operating lifetime of at least one of greater than 3 hours, greater than 30 hours, greater than 300 hours, or greater than 3000 hours.

8. The method of claim 1, wherein the hydrophobic barrier has a thickness that is at least one of less than 1 millimeter, less than 100 micrometers, less than 10 micrometers, less than 1 micrometer, or less than 0.1 micrometers.
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the hydrophobic barrier has a porosity that is at least one of greater than 0.1%, greater than 1%, greater than 10%, or greater than 30%.
